hooks.command: echo [se] WALK THE MACHINE: your FIRST action is the se_tick tool with no arguments - it shows where you are, its guidance, and what to do. Advance with se_tick {advance:true} (or {to:<state>}); when a state lists documents under read, READ them (they ride the packet or the lane), then se_tick {confirm:true}. When a result carries a banner, show it to the user VERBATIM and proceed with their request. The lane is locked until the machine reaches idle.
echo [se] context was compacted - call se_tick with no arguments to reorient. The one rule is unchanged: you work through the se MCP server, and you do what it tells you.
